scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/anthropic packages/openai packages/postgres packages/react packages/auth
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p examples/flights --noEmit && tsc -p examples/flights/tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p examples/hello --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello/tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p examples/hello-notices --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-notices/tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p examples/hello-auth --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-auth/tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run typetest && npm run csstest && npm run adaptertest && npm run storetest && npm run authtest && npm run reacttest && npm run uitest && npm run pgtest && npm run smoke
scripts.prepublish-check: npm run test && npm run packtest
scripts.example:flights: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/flights/src/server/main.ts
scripts.example:hello: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/hello/src/server/main.ts
scripts.example:hello-notices: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/hello-notices/src/server/main.ts
scripts.example:hello-auth: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/hello-auth/src/server/main.ts
scripts.release: npm run build && npx changeset publish
